name: LobsterPay
description: Permissioned payment layer for AI agents on Solana. Make payments, swaps, and x402 purchases through a policy-controlled vault — no private keys needed.

auth.instructions: Use the API key provided by the vault owner. Format: Bearer lp_live_xxxxx

tools.name: check_vault
tools.description: Check your vault status, token balances, and effective spending permissions. Call this first to understand what actions are allowed and how much budget remains.

response.balances: Array of token balances held by the vault. Each entry: { mint, symbol (nullable), amount (atomic string), uiAmount (number), decimals }. Empty array if vault holds no tokens yet.

permissions.maxPerTxAmountAtomic: Max amount per single transaction (atomic units)
permissions.dailyLimitAmountAtomic: Max total spend per day (atomic units)
permissions.maxSlippageBps: Max allowed slippage for swaps (basis points)

tools.name: make_payment
tools.description: Send tokens from the vault to an approved destination. The vault owner sets which destinations, mints, and amounts are allowed. All payments are idempotent — safe to retry with the same idempotencyKey.

parameters.name: mint
parameters.description: SPL token mint address. Common: USDC = EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v

parameters.name: amountAtomic
parameters.description: Amount in atomic units. For USDC (6 decimals): 1000000 = 1.00 USDC, 500000 = 0.50 USDC

parameters.name: destinationOwner
parameters.description: Solana wallet address of the payment recipient

parameters.name: idempotencyKey
parameters.description: Optional. Provide a unique string (e.g. 'invoice-123') only if you want to make retries safe — sending the same key with the same body won't double-charge. If omitted, the server generates a fresh identifier per request. Most agents don't need to set this.

parameters.name: memo
parameters.description: Optional memo describing the payment purpose

tools.name: get_swap_quote
tools.description: Get a quote for swapping one token for another through a DEX aggregator. Returns expected output, price impact, and route. Does NOT execute — call execute_swap to proceed.

parameters.name: maxSlippageBps
parameters.description: Max slippage in basis points. Default: 100 (1%)

tools.name: execute_swap
tools.description: Execute a token swap through the DEX aggregator. Subject to vault policy limits. Get a quote first to preview.

parameters.name: maxSlippageBps
parameters.description: Max slippage in basis points. Default: 100 (1%)

parameters.name: idempotencyKey
parameters.description: Optional. Provide a unique string only if you want safe retries. If omitted, the server generates a fresh identifier per request. Most agents don't need to set this.

tools.name: pay_x402
tools.description: Pay a 402-gated HTTP endpoint. When you get a 402 Payment Required, pass the paymentRequirements here; we validate against vault policy, settle the SPL transfer on-chain, and return a Solana tx signature plus an xPaymentHeader you can attach to the retry against originalRequestUrl so the upstream API releases the content.

parameters.name: paymentRequirements
parameters.description: Payment requirements from the 402 response. Must include: scheme ('exact'), network, asset (mint address), amount (atomic units), recipient (destination wallet). The `network` field accepts any of: 'solana' (cluster-agnostic, resolves to the server's configured cluster), 'solana-devnet', 'solana-mainnet', 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp' (CAIP-2 mainnet, per x402 spec), 'solana:EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1' (CAIP-2 devnet). The server rejects cluster-specific values that don't match its own cluster. Optional: paymentId for upstream dedup, expiresAt as an ISO string.

parameters.name: originalRequestUrl
parameters.description: The URL that returned the 402 response. Used for domain-based policy checks + audit trail.

parameters.name: idempotencyKey
parameters.description: Optional. Provide a unique string only if you want safe retries. If omitted, the server generates a fresh identifier per request. Most agents don't need to set this.

response.txSignature: Solana transaction signature (null until tx confirms)
response.paymentId: The upstream paymentId if the 402 included one
response.xPaymentHeader: Base64-encoded JSON proof the agent SHOULD set as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (or legacy X-PAYMENT) when retrying originalRequestUrl. Shape is the x402 v2 envelope: { x402Version: 2, scheme: 'exact', network, payload: { txSignature, maxAmountRequired, payTo, asset, amount, recipient, paymentId } }. `maxAmountRequired`/`payTo` are the v2 names; `amount`/`recipient` are included as back-compat aliases so upstream paywalls reading either work.
response.grossAmount: Amount paid in atomic units (same as paymentRequirements.amount)
response.netAmount: Amount the recipient actually received (gross minus the 1.5% service fee, enforced on-chain)
response.serviceFee: 1.5% service fee in atomic units, routed to the LobsterPay treasury

x402_retry_flow: 1. Agent GETs the paywalled URL, gets a 402 with paymentRequirements in the body. In x402 v2, the body is { x402Version: 2, accepts: [ { scheme, network, maxAmountRequired, payTo, asset, ... } ] }. Pass accepts[0] (or the legacy flat paymentRequirements alias if present) to pay_x402.

2. Agent forwards paymentRequirements intact to pay_x402 along with originalRequestUrl. The 402's `network` field is typically a CAIP-2 chain id like 'solana:EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1' (devnet) or 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp' (mainnet). Both are accepted. The server rejects cluster-specific values that don't match its own configured cluster.
3. On status: confirmed, agent retries the original URL with header 'PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: <xPaymentHeader>' (or legacy 'X-PAYMENT: <xPaymentHeader>' for older upstreams).
4. Upstream API verifies the Solana tx signature (by looking it up on-chain) and returns 200 + content.

compatibility.works_with: Upstream paywalled APIs that verify by looking up the Solana tx signature on-chain (amount + recipient + mint against getTransaction). Our own /v1/demo/x402/fortune and /v1/demo/x402/joke are reference implementations.
compatibility.does_not_work_with: Spec-conformant x402 FACILITATOR gateways (agonx402, Coinbase reference facilitator, etc.) that expect a pre-signed UNSUBMITTED transaction in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for the facilitator to submit after upstream success. LobsterPay's vault model settles the tx on-chain itself via a program-derived address (PDA); PDAs cannot produce the pre-signed-unsubmitted tx blob facilitators require, so the two designs do not interoperate. This is structural, not a schema gap - no header-shape change fixes it.

usage_notes: Always call check_vault first to understand your permissions and remaining budget
All amounts are in atomic units (smallest denomination). USDC has 6 decimals: 1 USDC = 1000000
idempotencyKey is optional — omit it and the server auto-generates one. Only set it when you specifically want to retry the same action safely.
Payments are only allowed to destinations on the vault's allowlist
If a payment is rejected, check the error — it will tell you if it's a limit, allowlist, or pause issue
The vault owner can revoke your API key at any time. Handle 401 errors gracefully.
